name: multi-links
title: Open Multiple Links
description: Opens all the links from the selected text in the default browser.
author: wrick17

commands.name: multi-links
commands.title: Open Multiple Links
commands.description: Opens all the links from the selected text in the default browser

commands.name: open-links-clipboard
commands.title: Open Multiple Links from Clipboard
commands.description: Opens all the links from the clipboard text in the default browser

commands.name: history
commands.title: Open Multiple Links History
commands.description: Browse and replay past batches of links

commands.name: filter
commands.title: Filter Multiple Links
commands.description: Group extracted links by domain and type; open selected

preferences.name: browser
preferences.title: Browser
preferences.description: Browser to open web URLs in. Default = system default. Local files, mailto:, and custom schemes always use the macOS default handler.

preferences.name: openDelayMs
preferences.title: Open Delay (ms)
preferences.description: Milliseconds between opens. 0 = parallel (chunked at 10). Higher values help cold-start apps (Obsidian, VSCode) accept URIs.

preferences.name: openAnyUriType
preferences.label: Open all URI types (mailto:, file:, custom schemes, local paths)
preferences.title: URI Types
preferences.description: When off, only http(s) and www. URLs open. Other extracted types are silently skipped.

preferences.name: confirmEnabled
preferences.label: Show confirmation when opening many links
preferences.title: Safety
preferences.description: When enabled, shows a confirmation dialog with type breakdown and a preview before opening a large batch.

preferences.name: confirmThreshold
preferences.title: Confirm Threshold
preferences.description: Show confirmation when extracted link count meets or exceeds this number.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
